hero.description: CoreSift scans the market, compares roles against your profile and brings the strongest-fit opportunities to the front. Move through the job market with more clarity and less wasted effort.
hero.trustCopy: 2,400+ people accelerated their search this week
hero.uploadDescription: PDF or Word — the system reads it, structures your profile and improves match quality.

items.title: Search every platform from one place
items.description: Bring LinkedIn, job boards and other sources into one product surface instead of losing time across tabs.

items.title: Intelligent profile-based matching
items.description: The system understands your CV, skills and preferences, then surfaces high-fit roles with a clear score.

items.title: See what is missing, strengthen the profile
items.description: Know which signals are weak or incomplete, then improve profile quality to unlock better matches.

how.label: How it works
how.title: Your CoreSift in 4 steps
how.description: Build the profile, launch the scan, review the best matches and apply faster.

steps.title: Create your profile
steps.description: Upload your CV or enter your key skills manually so the system can understand your profile.

steps.title: Scan the platforms
steps.description: 40+ job sources are scanned automatically and the market comes together in one structured flow.

steps.title: Review your matches
steps.description: Every role is ranked with a fit score so you can focus on the strongest opportunities first.

steps.title: Apply faster
steps.description: Move through the application process with more signal, more confidence and less wasted time.
